description: Enhance ResidentCalendar component with compact, interactive Apple-style UI including hover tooltips, click side panels, mobile swipe navigation, and visual refinements (dots instead of badges, glassmorphism, animations)
steps: 1. Read components/residents/ResidentCalendar.tsx and understand current structure (grid, events, summary panel)
2. Reduce calendar size: change date cell padding from current to 'p-1.5', date numbers to 'text-sm font-semibold', reduce overall calendar container padding, reduce header spacing

3. Replace large event badges with compact colored dots: render max 3 dots per cell (w-2 h-2 rounded-full) positioned at bottom with flex gap-0.5, show '+N' text for overflow (text-[9px] text-[#8E8E93])
4. Enhance hover tooltip (already exists): keep existing fixed positioning logic but ensure smooth transitions with 'transition-all duration-200', improve visual hierarchy in tooltip content

5. Add click interaction with Sheet component: import Sheet/SheetContent/SheetHeader/SheetTitle from @/components/ui/sheet, add state 'const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<string | null>(null)', onClick handler sets selectedDate to dateKey, Sheet opens on right side (desktop) showing all events for that date with full details and resident profile link
6. Add cell hover animation: add 'hover:scale-[1.03] hover:shadow-md' to date cells, ensure transition-all duration-200 is applied
7. Enhance today highlight: add 'ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] ring-offset-1 animate-pulse' to today's date cell (already has isToday check)
8. Apply glassmorphism to calendar container: add 'bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/60 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04),0_4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]' to outer Card wrapper

9. Refactor summary panel: convert large summary section to horizontal row of 4 compact floating stat cards (Days Stayed, Pending Rent, Pending Electricity, Next Due) with small gradient backgrounds (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-[color]/10 to-[color]/5)

10. Add mobile swipe navigation: add onTouchStart/onTouchEnd handlers to calendar grid div to track horizontal swipe (threshold ~50px), call goToPreviousMonth on right swipe, goToNextMonth on left swipe

11. Add week view toggle (mobile only): add state 'const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'month' | 'week'>('month')', add toggle buttons above calendar (visible on lg:hidden), when week mode filter calendarDays to show only current week (7 days starting from most recent Sunday)

12. Update color scheme: ensure all event colors match spec (joining #34C759, rent-due pending #FF3B30, rent-due partial #FF9500, rent-due paid #34C759, payment #30D158, plan-change #007AFF, electricity #5856D6, notice/leaving #FF9500)
13. Test all interactions: hover shows tooltip, click opens side sheet, swipe changes month on mobile, week toggle works, animations are smooth
acceptance_criteria: Calendar cells are 30-40% smaller than original with compact padding and font sizes
Events render as colored dots (max 3 visible + overflow count), not large badges
Hovering a date with events shows a floating tooltip with event details
Clicking a date with events opens a Sheet side panel (right side) with full event list and navigation links
Today's date has a pulsing blue ring animation
Calendar container has glassmorphism effect (frosted glass appearance)
Summary stats display as 4 compact horizontal cards with gradient backgrounds
Swiping left/right on mobile changes the month
Mobile view has a toggle between month and week views
All event colors match the specified Apple palette
Animations are CSS-only (no external libraries) with smooth transitions
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm TypeScript compilation succeeds
Start dev server with 'npm run dev' and navigate to a resident profile page
Click the Timeline tab to view the calendar
Verify calendar is visibly more compact than before
Verify events show as small colored dots instead of badges
Hover over a date with events and confirm tooltip appears
Click a date with events and confirm Sheet opens on the right with event details
Verify today's date has a pulsing blue ring
On mobile viewport (320px-768px), swipe horizontally on calendar and confirm month changes
On mobile viewport, verify week/month toggle buttons appear and function correctly
Verify glassmorphism effect on calendar container
findings:
All enhancements implemented successfully:
1. Calendar cells reduced by ~40% (padding: p-1.5, font: text-sm)
2. Events render as colored dots (w-2 h-2, max 3 + overflow count)
3. Hover tooltips enhanced with smooth transitions (transition-all duration-200)
4. Click interaction opens Sheet side panel with full event details and profile link
5. Date cells have hover animation (hover:scale-[1.03] hover:shadow-md)
6. Today's date has pulsing blue ring (ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] ring-offset-1 animate-pulse)
7. Glassmorphism applied (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm with multi-layer shadows)
8. Summary panel refactored to 4 compact horizontal gradient cards
9. Mobile swipe navigation implemented (threshold 50px, left/right swipe changes month)
10. Week/month toggle added for mobile (lg:hidden, filters to 7 days)
11. All event colors updated to match Apple palette (electricity: #5856D6, leaving: #FF9500, rent_due dynamic based on status)
12. Dynamic rent_due colors: paid=#34C759, partial=#FF9500, pending=#FF3B30

Build completed successfully with no TypeScript errors.
